outputs.discrepancies: The caption states HMGB1 was decreased in all three subcellular fractions (nucleus, cytosol, mitochondria) in Atxn1-KI mice and that this downregulation was reversed in the double-transgenic mice in all three fractions. The nuclear and mitochondrial fraction graphs do show a significant decrease in Atxn1-KI (marked with * and #) that is reversed in Atxn1-KI;HMGB1 mice, consistent with the caption. However, the cytosolic fraction graph shows only a modest, non-significant change (no significance markers at all) across the three genotypes, which does not support the caption's claim of downregulation and reversal in the cytosolic fraction.
